title: 火箭为什么能飞上天
subtitle: 往下喷，就往上飞
character: wearing an orange t-shirt, khaki shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in retro space poster style, flat bold shapes with a limited palette of cream, orange, teal and deep navy, clean simple forms and slight printed grain

pages.zh:
我在电视上看见火箭发射。
轰——
它喷着火，慢慢升起来，
越飞越快，
最后变成天上的一个小点。
pages.scene: The little boy sits on the floor in front of a television watching a rocket lift off, his mouth open in amazement, warm room light.

pages.zh:
火箭为什么能飞上天呢？
因为它一直往下喷气。
往下喷得越用力，
它就被推得越往上。
这股力量，叫做「推力」。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one tall cream rocket standing upright in the middle of a navy background, with a thick orange flame pointing straight down from its bottom and one bold white arrow pointing straight up beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
吹气球的时候也一样。
把气球吹大，
手一松，
气从后面呼呼地跑出来，
气球就往前飞出去了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one teal balloon flying to the right on a cream background, with a small stream of air drawn escaping from its open end to the left and one bold arrow pointing right beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
火箭要飞得很快很快。
慢了就会被地球拉回来。
只有快到每秒七点九公里，
才能绕着地球飞，
掉不下来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one rocket flying to the right high above a curved section of the earth on a navy background, a long white dotted line showing its path curving around the planet. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
火箭的肚子里装的不是货，
是燃料。
又重又满满一大箱，
烧起来才有力气，
把自己顶上天。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one rocket drawn in cross-section on a cream background, its inside filled with two large tanks coloured orange and teal, labelled only by colour, the engine at the bottom. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
燃料烧完了怎么办？
空箱子还很重，
带着它飞太费力。
所以火箭会分成几段，
烧完一段，就扔掉一段。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one rocket in mid-flight on a navy background with its lower section separating and falling away downward, the upper section continuing up with a small flame. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最上面那一小截，
才是真正要去太空的部分。
里面坐着宇航员，
或者装着卫星。
它又轻又小，飞得最远。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: the small top section of a rocket flying alone in a navy starry background, a rounded capsule shape with a small window. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
飞出大气层以后，
天就不再是蓝色了。
上面没有空气，
太阳照着也不暖，
那里又黑又静。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: a tall vertical strip on the right of the picture showing the sky changing from pale blue at the bottom to deep black at the top, with one small rocket near the top. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
卫星会留在天上，
一圈一圈地绕着地球转。
有的帮我们看天气，
有的帮我们打电话、
找路、看电视。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one blue-and-green earth in the middle of a navy background with three small satellites on thin dotted circles around it, each satellite with two flat solar panels. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
宇航员回家的时候，
坐着小小的返回舱。
它冲进大气层，
外面烧得通红，
里面却是安全的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one rounded capsule falling through the sky on a navy background, a glowing orange arc of heat drawn under its base, its shape intact. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
快到地面的时候，
返回舱打开降落伞。
大大的伞一张开，
它就慢慢地、稳稳地
落到地上。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one rounded capsule hanging under three large open parachutes on a cream sky background, descending slowly toward a simple line of ground at the bottom. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我用积木也搭了一支火箭。
它有尖尖的头，
有长长的身体，
还有三条腿。
数到十，就发射！
pages.scene: The little boy kneels on the floor beside a tall rocket he has built from building blocks, one hand raised as if counting down, laughing.
